case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are identified in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under ss.302/34, 460 and 324 IPC.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court modified conviction to s.304 Part I and acquitted under s.302.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court allowed appeal and restored trial court conviction.

offence_finally_established.reason: Supreme Court held the offence falls under s.302 IPC.

imprisonment_type.quote: convicted and sentenced the accused under Sections 302/34, 460 and 324

imprisonment_years.reason: No term of imprisonment is stated anywhere in the judgment.

neutral_facts.reason: Says accused were handed over to police, which is not stated; sequence of stabbing is also loosely described.

offence_severity.reason: Minimum and maximum punishment ranges are not stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: Victim died, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death of deceased and injuries to witnesses are described.

number_of_offences.reason: Three offences charged; trial conviction on all three restored by Supreme Court.

financial_property_loss.quote: entered the premises at mid night duly armed with the intention of committing robbery
financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment does not state property loss; 'Not applicable' is an inference, not stated.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Accused entered armed at midnight with intention of committing robbery; premeditation not expressly found
premeditation_planning.quote: duly armed with the intention of committing robbery
premeditation_planning.reason: Armed entry with robbery intent is stated, but the court does not expressly find premeditation.

motive.reason: Initial purpose of the intrusion was committing robbery.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Accused entered armed at midnight for robbery; A-2 stabbed deceased in stomach; both accused injured thighs; death followed
key_evidence_accepted.quote: A2 had caused one injury in the stomach of the deceased while he lay on top of him
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Thigh injuries were caused by A-2 and the other accused jointly, not A-2 alone.

witness_credibility.reason: Court relied on testimony of P.W. 1 to 4 for the sequence of events.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: P.Ws. 1 and 2 overpowered A-2 and pushed him from balcony; neighbours caught A-1; accused tied with rope; police informed
post_offence_conduct.quote: P.Ws.1 and 2 over powered A-2 and pushed him from balcony
post_offence_conduct.reason: Family witnesses, not neighbours, overpowered A-2; 'later apprehended' is loosely stated.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: 20th/21st November 1991; High Court judgment: 11.12.2003; trial court judgment date: Not stated; Supreme Court decision: December 14, 2010

trial_duration.reason: 11.12.2003 is the High Court judgment date, not the trial judgment; High Court date is listed as not stated.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellant and respondents match the judgment.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court modification, and Supreme Court restoration are accurately summarized.

prosecution_argument.quote: The High Court has been influenced by the fact that there was no common intention

defence_argument.quote: A2 dealt a knife blow in the process of extricating himself

sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale is supported, but no 'final sentence' is imposed or stated.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are identified by the court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Armed midnight entry for robbery; repeated effective knife use; injuries to neighbours; threats of dire consequences
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court's reasoning relies on these aggravating features, though not labelled as such.
